dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent central 'O' shaped structure with a soft-edged light gray perimeter and a darker interior core; flanked dorsally by two interlocking 'C' shaped patterns with diffuse gradient transitions; one additional irregular 'O' structure visible in the posterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Isolated singular high-intensity white pixel cluster located on the ventral-lateral margin near the center-point of the longitudinal axis; low overall density of solid high-intensity clusters across the remaining surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangle is formed by connecting the centroid of the primary central 'O' annulus, the centroid of the dorsal-most 'C' shape, and the singular high-intensity white point on the lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast white point located at the lower-central boundary of the segment, contrasting sharply with the surrounding low-intensity pixel field.
